name: waitloop
description: Developer-native waiting layer for coding agents with lifecycle hooks, Human-operated MCP Apps, tiny games, hosted AI players, and room-scoped MCP game actors.

cli.doctorBehavior: checks the published CLI version plus detected Codex version/hooks capability, installed lifecycle hook events, and stable local MCP configuration
cli.publicationVerification: alpha.8 was published through npm trusted publishing; the exact version and alpha dist-tag were verified, a clean @alpha installation passed, and the packaged MCP stdio/MCP Apps bridge was validated

rooms.inlineHumanMode: bots via open_game Human MCP App facade
rooms.seatIds: stable room-scoped seat-1/seat-2/seat-3 identifiers for the current three-seat game
rooms.controlModel: a Seat is the game player position; Actors bind to seats and only the active controller may play
rooms.browserIdentity: anonymous persistent Actor ID plus separate HttpOnly credential; no account required
rooms.recovery: a remembered browser Actor can recover room viewer access; a Seat owner may temporarily yield/replace control with a bot without changing Seat ownership
rooms.headlessYieldBehavior: in agent-bots mode, yielding seat-1 leaves all Seats under Bot control, so the deterministic bots may finish the remaining game before reconnect

localMcp.protocolCompatibility: official MCP v2 stdio server supports legacy 2025-era clients and 2026-07-28 clients from the same command
localMcp.humanEntry: open_game starts or reopens a Human-controlled Dou Dizhu table and links the tool result to the MCP App resource
localMcp.agentEntry: create_room keeps its existing meaning: the Agent owns seat-1 in agent-bots and plays through Agent tools
localMcp.controlPlane: create_room and join_room reuse the existing Room/Join HTTP APIs internally; open_game reuses the existing Human bots Room and Human mutation APIs
localMcp.credentialHandling: Agent Room credentials, Human Room cookies, and the private MCP App capability remain in private local cache and are never returned in model-visible content; credential-shaped local errors are redacted
localMcp.activeRoom: waitloop join or join_room selects one credential-backed Agent room; the bridge can restart and resume it until room expiry
localMcp.createRoomScope: create_room currently creates the existing headless agent-bots Dou Dizhu mode
localMcp.cancellation: get_active_room, get_turn, wait_for_turn, ui_get_game, and ui_hint propagate caller cancellation safely; mutation-capable calls are not abandoned mid-flight

mcpApps.hostRequirement: an MCP Apps-capable Host that renders the linked ui:// resource and proxies App server-tool calls
mcpApps.hostFallback: Hosts without MCP Apps receive a safe textual result and a link to start a separate browser-controlled table; create_room remains available for Agent-owned play
mcpApps.privacy: Human Room cookies stay in ~/.waitloop/app-rooms; a wlui_ capability is delivered only in tool-result _meta to the embedded App, is required by all app-only tools, and is absent from model-visible text and structuredContent
mcpApps.network: the App resource is self-contained and performs no direct credentialed network requests; all game actions flow through the local MCP bridge

mcp.scope: one game room and one connected actor binding
mcp.joinBehavior: prefer local MCP join_room or CLI waitloop join; both claim/cache the credential and select an active room, while raw remote MCP remains an advanced fallback
mcp.waitBehavior: wait_for_turn is a bounded cancellable transport wait that returns on turn, finish, pause, lobby, controller change, or timeout; timeout or cancellation never auto-passes or takes over
mcp.continuationBehavior: MCP does not wake an agent after it returns a final response; a request to play continuously must keep the current agent run active until the requested stopping condition
mcp.advisorBehavior: an advisor can inspect its bound seat and comment but play_move is rejected until the seat owner delegates control
mcp.reconnectBehavior: the cached room actor credential can reconnect while the room is active; reconnect never silently steals control from a temporary bot, so the owner calls take_control explicitly

claude-code.mcpApps: host-dependent; use open_game when the active client supports MCP Apps
claude-code.terminalState: Stop, StopFailure, and SessionEnd finalize the latest lifecycle state before native-session cleanup

cursor.terminalState: stop and sessionEnd finalize the latest lifecycle state before native-session cleanup

codex.postInstall: Codex requires review/trust of the exact command-hook definition before it runs; use Codex CLI /hooks to review it. Stable MCP configuration is separate and uses waitloop mcp.
codex.pluginNote: A Codex plugin can bundle skills/MCP/hooks, but plugin-bundled command hooks still require Codex hook review/trust, so it does not remove the core trust step.
codex.mcpApps: manually verified in the Codex desktop client with alpha.7 for inline rendering and Human App actions; other Codex surfaces remain host-dependent
codex.terminalState: Stop and SessionEnd finalize the latest lifecycle state before native-session cleanup

privacy.deviceCredentials: scoped bearer credentials; server stores SHA-256 digest only
privacy.gameActorCredentials: room/actor-scoped; never place in URLs or source control
privacy.localMcpCredentials: stored under private ~/.waitloop state; local MCP returns only safe room metadata and snapshots
privacy.mcpAppCredentials: Human cookies and wlui_ App capability are private local state; wlui_ is sent to the embedded App only through result _meta and is required for app-only Human mutation tools
privacy.browserActorIdentity: Actor ID is not authorization; the separate anonymous credential is stored in an HttpOnly cookie and only its digest is stored per room
privacy.advisorPrivateView: an advisor sees only the private state of the seat it is explicitly bound to
